title: Impl: pkt_id counter and assignment in Python link layer
description: Add monotonic u32 pkt_id counter to LinkLayer class. Assign new pkt_id in LinkLayer.receive() for RX frames. Assign new pkt_id in TxQueue.push() for locally-originated TX. Add pkt_id field to receive return value (ReceiveResult or equivalent). Thread pkt_id through Node._process_received(). File: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py, python/src/lichen/link/tx_queue.py, python/src/lichen/node.py. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_link*.py -x
